title: Maximum angular velocity
description: Essential: Correctly states or derives the condition ω ≤ √(μ₁g/R) and provides the final answer √(g/(2R)).

title: Minimum table radius
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the minimum radius R₁ = √(x₁² + R²) and provides the final answer √2 R.

title: Total fall time
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the total time t = t₁ + t₂ and provides the final answer 2√(2R/g).

title: Centripetal force condition
description: Important: Applies Newton's second law for circular motion, equating maximum static friction (μ₁mg) to the required centripetal force (mω²R).

title: Kinematics on table
description: Important: Correctly models the sliding phase on the table using constant deceleration a = μ₂g and kinematic equations to find slide distance or time.

title: Projectile fall time
description: Important: Correctly calculates the free-fall time t₂ from height R using R = (1/2)gt₂².

title: Geometry application
description: Important: Correctly applies the Pythagorean theorem to relate slide distance to table radius (R₁ or R₂).

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect sign for acceleration on the table (should be deceleration) or misapplies kinematic equation signs.

title: Friction force confusion
description: Pitfall: Confuses μ₁ and μ₂, applying the wrong coefficient for the disk or table surface.
